Tumhari success tumhare mindset se decide hogi.
"Knockdown matter nahi—matter karta: uthte ho ya nahi."
Tumhara samay seemit hai, kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbaad mat karo.
Discomfort admission ka paisa hai.
Success focus aur continuous effort maangti hai.
Koshish nahi karoge toh kabhi nahi jeetoge.
Perfection nahi—progress ka strive.
"Tum jo karte usse matter banta—tum decide karo kaunsa."
Chalte raho; mushkil badhe toh growth bhi badhe.
"Sabse bada risk: risk na lena."
